specs.title: P10 real signed decision current rules impact proposal and scoped audit evidence
P10 approval requires acknowledgement MFA and authoritative receipt only
P10 explicit reject requires reason and actual audit receipt
P10 explicit request_info requires reason and actual audit receipt
P10 expiry and independent actor self match disable all decisions
P10 concurrent conflict clears facts and blocks further actions until explicit review
P10 committed lost response preserves exact body key and version with explicit recovery
P10 actual changed kill risk is separated from immutable request decision and refuses approval
P10 stale review disables write then explicit refresh recovers without auto-submit
P10 C10 denial is isolated and raw backend error stays hidden
P10 nonapprover viewer and unknown injected routes cannot read inbox facts
P10 noReview refuses unbound context without a fake risk card
P10 foreignReview refuses unbound context without a fake risk card
P10 local filters deep links and empty loading states remain read-only
P10 offline clears all sensitive risk context evidence reason and pending intent
P10 429 enforces bounded explicit cooldown without retrying writes
P10 high fidelity dark light desktop mobile axe keyboard and lower action layout
P20 actual intent-risk-independent approval-command sequence creates only confirmed server order
P20 committed lost risk locks flow and recovers original key/body only
P20 committed lost command locks flow and recovers original key/body only
P20 independent refusal remains visible and never grants command submission
P20 risk confirmation Escape and current version conflict do not acknowledge or submit commands
P20 source fields remain owned and missing depth cash TIF are explicitly unknown
P20 symbol mismatch and injected authority do not reuse a server proposal
P20 current source deterioration refuses risk; stream failure does not retry writes
P20 viewer offline and actual logout revoke all sensitive workflow facts
P20 loading empty and 429 retain unknown readiness and bounded explicit retry
P20 actual layout light dark desktop tablet mobile axe controls and evidence detail
